push.title: W 3-0 vs LOS REGIDOS | You: 9.3
push.body:
Hoo-wee, PhogsToffees. A 9.3. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at LOS REGIDOS's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ Man of the Match, your 10th for us. Put that one on the fridge.
+ tuxedo_slide scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 3. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Focus point: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 64% passing (14 of 22, down from your usual 78%). Between you and me: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Water the plant.
- You and BellyTb1: forcing passes. Two-person fix: give each other short options.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 1). Tell you what: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

Skills corner: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Rest up, legend. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs LOS REGIDOS | You: 6.5 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.5 against LOS REGIDOS. You battled, and battling's the part you can always control.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against LOS REGIDOS, your first since Oct 4. You finished it like the last bite of a good steak.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 3. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 4. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Giveaways 3, down from your usual 12. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of LOS REGIDOS. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. Tiny tweak: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 6. Quick fix: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Simple fix: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 6). From the clipboard: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

THE UGLY
! Only 2 passes (down from your usual 14). We lost the match right there. Old coach's advice: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Daily reps: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

tuxedo_slide, take this with you: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

Keep showing up; the results will too. - Coach Lasso
